scope: Development questions 11, 16 and 18; criteria recorded before this batch. No claim of independent or blinded grading.
general: Core facts agree with the pinned Flask source.

required: The core chain is object -> Scaffold -> flask.sansio.blueprints.Blueprint -> flask.blueprints.Blueprint.
SansioBlueprint is the alias used by the public Blueprint class for its base.
The public class is exported as flask.Blueprint.
optional: The distinction between class inheritance and nested-blueprint registration.

required: route returns a decorator that calls self.add_url_rule and returns the original function.
The endpoint defaults to the view function name; URL rules and endpoint-to-view mappings are stored separately.
Methods default to GET and automatic OPTIONS depends on the explicit option, view attributes and configuration.
Registration is distinguished from request-time dispatch; endpoint collisions with different view functions are rejected.
optional: Setup guard after the first request.
Registering an endpoint before binding a view.

required: WSGI entry leads through wsgi_app and request_context to AppContext.from_environ in this revision.
The request is constructed with app.request_class(environ), assigned the app JSON provider and stored in a context.
The default request class is replaceable; flask.request is a context-bound proxy rather than a shared request object.
optional: ContextVar binding when the context is pushed.
The current merge of request and app contexts.
